name: Malthace
title: Wife of Herod the Great
summary: Malthace was one of Herod the Great's wives and the mother of Archelaus and Herod Antipas, both of whom came to rule parts of the kingdom after their father's death.

keyEvents.title: Mother of two rulers
keyEvents.description: Malthace was the mother of Archelaus, who ruled Judea, and Herod Antipas, who ruled Galilee during Jesus' time.
